title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Spending and Cash Limits
content:
**Cardholder terms, Schedule of Limits.** The following purchase and ATM limits apply to the Pocketwire Visa Debit Card. All amounts are in USD. A calendar day is a calendar day in Eastern Time.

| Card tier | Daily purchase limit | Per-transaction purchase limit | Virtual-card daily purchase limit | Daily ATM withdrawal limit | ATM withdrawals per day |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Visa Classic Debit | 5000.00 | 2500.00 | 1000.00 | 500.00 | 3 |
| Pocketwire Visa Gold Debit | 7500.00 | 5000.00 | 2500.00 | 700.00 | 3 |
| Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit | 10000.00 | 7500.00 | 5000.00 | 1000.00 | 5 |
| Pocketwire Visa Signature Debit | 15000.00 | 10000.00 | 7500.00 | 1000.00 | 5 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Debit | 25000.00 | 15000.00 | 10000.00 | 1500.00 | 6 |
| Pocketwire Visa Infinite Metal Debit | 50000.00 | 25000.00 | 25000.00 | 2500.00 | 10 |

**Definitions used in this schedule**

1. *Daily purchase limit*: the cap on the total of settled purchases on one calendar day across all of the customer's cards.
2. *Per-transaction purchase limit*: the maximum amount of a single purchase.
3. *Virtual-card daily purchase limit*: the cap on the total of purchases made with virtual cards on one calendar day. These purchases also count towards the daily purchase limit.
4. *Daily ATM withdrawal limit*: the cap on the total of ATM withdrawals on one calendar day across all of the customer's cards.
5. *ATM withdrawals per day*: the maximum number of ATM withdrawals on one calendar day.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** On Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit, a single purchase of 7500.00 is within the per-transaction limit, and a single purchase of 7500.01 is above it. If a customer has already made 9000.00 of settled purchases today, a further 1000.00 brings the day to exactly 10000.00, which is still within the daily purchase limit.
